text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The race is moving on from swimming to
running. Athletes head to the
kitchen to
start on their mission!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Each has the base for a plain sports
drink. Their job is to flavor it with
the ingredients
at their disposal and hand it off to the
third athlete in their team!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! My list of nutritious foods!
Now
to see which ones are good
for keeping
tiredness at bay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want an ingredient that relieves
tiredness, and one that enhances

endurance too. Soybean and lemon sounds
like a tasty combo...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A simple honey and lemon mix will do. I'm
not wasting any time on
making this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at all these ingredients! Which
ones should I use
together? ♪ Prunes and
cinnamon... Ooh, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega has finished making her drink
and is heading to the next
checkpoint!
Satono Diamond follows closely behind
her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, uhh... Okay, just gotta add this
bifido-something yogurt and I
should be
all done! Then finally, a taste test!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now at the second checkpoint, the next
set of athletes is standing by.
Admire Vega
is in the lead and is expected to come
into view any minute now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, Ayabe's in the lead?! I can't mess
this up! I can't mess this up!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... There it is... the checkpoint!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Oh no you don't! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega and Satono Diamond race
toward their teammates, leaving the
competition in the dust! Both make a swift
baton
exchange!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's bike accelerates
like a
rocket! It looks like she'll
catch up to
Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ryaaan! I'm sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I've got it from here!
Keep going,
just a bit longer!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now halfway through the third leg, we're
approaching the mountain crossing. From
here the route splits into three. Will
athletes choose the short but steep
mountain climb...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
...The lengthy detour around the
mountain, or something in the
middle?
Leader Meisho Doto opts for the medium
hill route.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto has dismounted and taken
off her helmet. It looks like
she's stopped
to drink the sports drink she received
from her teammate!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp... Ahhh! It's so nice and sweet!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
I could finish this up right now! It'll
come out faster if I squeeze
the bottle a
little! Ei!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I spilled it... Aww...
now my hands are all
sticky...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzz, bzz...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-b-bees?! WAAAHHH! LEAVE ME
ALOOONE!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Owie!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... My bike! WAAAAAH! The wheel
came off! It's b-b-brokeeen!
WAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O has opted for the
riverside detour. A surprising
choice,
considering long distances are not her
specialty!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I've made it... halfway. I'm not that tired... It's just downhill from here...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hng?! Is this flavor... sakura mochi?! She
knows what I like! Hehe, now
I'm powered
up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... It gets even steeper from here, huh? Although this is the shortest route, the others might still widen their lead if I'm slow on the way up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp. Is this... an edamame shake?! It's refreshing, though. Tastes like edamame, yogurt, lemon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh I get it, Tannhauser made me a
recovery drink! She must've been

well-prepared for any mission that came
her way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I won't let her efforts go to waste! I'm
gonna climb this mountain and
close the
gap!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...
Th-the more I try to f-fix my bike,
the worse it gets! What do I
do, what do I
do?! Hnggg...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... I... I have to go...
Top Road is waiting
for me! I've gotta keep
going! I've gotta
keep going! I can do thiiis!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Who will be first to arrive at the third
checkpoint and meet our
anchors? The
cheers are gradually approaching! In the
lead is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O! It's Sakura Bakushin O!
Behind her, Mejiro Ryan
and Meisho Doto
are in hot pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Baku... shin... Baku... shin! Bakushin...
SHIIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I didn't have to pedal much on the
way down... Seems that
saved me some
energy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You didn't pedal on the way down... Oh!
Our unicycle training! So
that's what it was
for!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just wanted to ride unicycles. But
that works too! Go on,
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Despite everyone's fears, I took on
the challenge of the longest
route, and I
made it through victorious!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no obstacle I cannot overcome!
Bakushin, Bakushin,
Bakushin, Bakushin,
BAKUSHIIIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: RYAAAN! KEEP AT IT!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I will! My legs feel lighter than usual!
Time
to show what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Go Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAH! TOP ROOOAD! Sob, sob... WAAAHAAA!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's okay, Doto! You're almost there!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
First in is Sakura Bakushin O! She's kept
her lead and passed the
baton to Kitasan
Black!
